# PT. Murfy Alam Indonesia

> Factory-direct exporter of Sukabumi Green Stone (Pedra Bali), black lava stone and andesite from Sukabumi, West Java, Indonesia. We supply export-grade pool tiles, pool coping, mesh-mounted mosaics, wall cladding and paving to importers, pool builders, architects and resort developers worldwide.

Contact: giat@zeofa.com | WhatsApp +62 851-4156-7350 | Sukabumi, West Java, Indonesia
Response time: within 24 hours on business days. Terms: FOB, CFR, CIF from Tanjung Priok, Jakarta.

## Key facts

- Product: Sukabumi Green Stone, also known worldwide as Pedra Bali — a zeolite-rich green quartzite quarried only in Sukabumi, West Java, Indonesia.
- The zeolite content naturally helps keep pool water clear; water absorption is below 0.4%, making it suitable for freeze-thaw climates.
- We are the factory: quarry selection, cutting, grading and ISPM-15 export packing happen at our own facility.
- Minimum order: one 20-ft container (approx. 550–650 m² of 20 mm tiles); LCL trial orders possible.
- We ship to 180+ countries; each market page at /export/{country} lists port, transit time and FAQ.
